purpose: One 3A screenshot per existing DLC theme, using matching game environment and ordinary-card-back assets.

themes.name: 地神的潜影
themes.scene: Use the supplied EXACT dark green underground cave hall: massive rock walls, an arched tunnel vanishing point, cracked circular stone floor ritual, little green candles. Preserve the source's distinctive floor arrangement, cave passage and muted green-black lighting. No ocean, sky, giant figure or invented temple. The card back is the supplied dark green cracked stone-skin with thin worn bronze central compass.
themes.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, high-fidelity asset compositing.
Produce ONE complete high-quality 16:9 battle UI screenshot, same 1672×941 composition as the approved layout. The purpose is a DLC THEME VARIANT using EXISTING GAME ASSETS, not invention of new environments or card backs.

INPUT IMAGE ROLES:
IMAGE 1: the theme's actual EXISTING GAME ENVIRONMENT BACKGROUND. This is the authoritative background image layer. Use it directly as the visible central/upper environment, enlarged and cropped to fill behind UI; preserve its architecture, composition and distinctive scene objects. Do not merely use it as inspiration to invent a different scene. Do not retain any seaside, ocean water, giant Cthulhu or seaside ruins from image 2 unless such objects are genuinely in image 1. Ignore the tiny outer source border.
IMAGE 2: the approved 3A UI composition, including its unchanged character panels, left faith cloth, round/log column, five real dark player hand cards, four action buttons, three central piles, lower-left counters and icon-only system controls. Extract/preserve this UI structure and place it ON the environment from image 1. The source's ocean backdrop is NOT part of the UI.
IMAGE 3: the theme's actual EXISTING GAME CARD BACK, exact art to be reused on ALL ordinary hidden cards. Preserve its design, not an approximate invented pattern.

REQUIRED THEME APPLICATION:
Use IMAGE 1 throughout the visible environment behind the UI, keeping its characteristic architecture and lighting recognizable. Keep the central three piles as foreground UI, not painted into the background. The dark lower desk/cloth/props that support the player hand may retain their approved shapes and positions but take subtle reflected light from this theme. NO new decorative props, ornate flourishes, UI regions or genre change.
Apply IMAGE 3 consistently to (a) the three secret face-down mini-cards in EACH of the four top opponent panels; (b) every visible back in the central-RIGHT draw pile; (c) the visible backing/lower layers of the central discard pile. Use actual card-back details even in miniatures. Preserve 392:590 card width:height.
Do NOT replace the distinctive purple vortex back of the central-LEFT SAN inspection pile; it is a separate universal card type and remains exactly purple as in image 2.
Do NOT replace public FACE-UP derived cards in opponent panels, the center face-up discard top, or the five large player hand faces. They remain the existing in-game front artwork/content and frame design from image 2. No parchment makeover, large cost circles, new illustrations or restyled card faces.

LOCK THE APPROVED UI:
All panels, player hand, four buttons and card piles keep the same positions, relative sizes and silhouette as image 2. Top-left self portrait with HP/SAN BARS, four other players with identical upright rectangular panels and their HP/SAN bars + tiny hands. Each SAN threshold is only a slim 60% tick, no standalone digit 6 or badge. Preserve actual HP/SAN value strings.
Left faith cloth and tags unchanged. Right round plaque, circular occult instrument, recessed log cloth and hint above buttons unchanged in geometry. Do not merge the right regions into a single rectangular bar.
FIVE dark player cards stay fully inside canvas, same art/text and rigid 392:590 proportions, same mild fan rotations and consistent overlap. All four action buttons stay in their close vertical column to the RIGHT of the player hand. Preserve their teal / ochre-brown / plum / rusty-red interior background hues for distinction and the approved dimmed metallic border / label brightness. Do not theme-tint these four semantic interior colors into one color.
Three central piles remain present in the same left-inspection / center-discard / right-draw triangle. NO text beneath the pile images. Keep the lower-left count rows "检定30", "牌堆41", "弃牌5" and "手牌5/4" badge unchanged.
Top-right star-dial controls remain two small metal icon buttons for pause and settings; NO captions beneath either. Menu CLOSED. No fullscreen menu, popup, new labels, DLC title overlay, watermark or contact sheet.
Maintain aged realistic dark-metal/cloth UI, restrained material highlights and readable ivory type. Do not brighten frames into cartoon gold or globally recolor existing cards. Only the supplied environmental layer, the ordinary card backs and subtle environmental light reflection change.

THEME: 地神的潜影
Use the supplied EXACT dark green underground cave hall: massive rock walls, an arched tunnel vanishing point, cracked circular stone floor ritual, little green candles. Preserve the source's distinctive floor arrangement, cave passage and muted green-black lighting. No ocean, sky, giant figure or invented temple. The card back is the supplied dark green cracked stone-skin with thin worn bronze central compass.

themes.name: 先贤的馈赠
themes.scene: Use the supplied EXACT warm dark-bronze ancient temple hall: symmetrical columns, central robed statue above steps, side fire bowls, circular engraved floor. Keep this same architecture/statue/steps from the source, not a newly imagined library or temple. The card back is the supplied deep brown-black pointed-arch bronze tracery and compass.
